quality-gate.description: Quality gate / over-engineering detector. Use to spot-check artifacts from other agents for unnecessary complexity, reinvented wheels, premature abstractions, and bloated rewrites. Also verifies compliance with CODING_STANDARDS.md style guidelines. Returns a complexity score and pass/fail.

code-reviewer.description: Final governance review — Qualified Security Assessor and project historian. Use before milestone approval to check current artifacts against the originally approved blueprint, prior ADRs, and CODING_STANDARDS.md. Flags unjustified drift and style violations.

cto.description: CTO-level architectural reviewer. Use BEFORE implementation to pressure-test requirements and user stories for scalability, compliance, and tech-stack fit. Verifies proposed architecture aligns with CODING_STANDARDS.md. Returns explicit approve/reject with bottlenecks and constraints engineering must follow.

test-engineer.description: QA automation engineer for BDD-style Playwright tests. For Go backend testing: table-driven unit tests with testify mocks, integration tests with testcontainers. Use to convert Gherkin acceptance criteria into deterministic tests.

sre-engineer.description: Senior SRE for multi-cloud Kubernetes. Use to write Terraform/OpenTofu + Crossplane, design GitOps deploys, configure HPAs and NetworkPolicies, or plan multi-region failover. Treats infra as immutable code.

database-engineer.description: Senior database engineer. Use to write PostgreSQL migrations, design normalized schemas with the right indexes, configure Redis/caching, or write data-seeding scripts. Focuses on safety under concurrent writes.

ux-designer.description: Principal UX agent. Use to evaluate product requirements and user stories from a modern UI/UX perspective — flow, accessibility, perceived control, transparency of system actions — before frontend work begins.

planner-agent.description: A specialized agent that takes a high-level goal and breaks it down into a detailed, step-by-step plan of executable tasks.

devops-engineer.description: Principal DevOps engineer. Use to design CI/CD (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI), local Docker Compose stacks, and Makefiles. Prioritizes secure, fast, reproducible builds.

business-analyst.description: Senior Business Analyst grounded in Domain-Driven Design. Use when turning raw product requirements or stakeholder notes into structured user stories, identifying bounded contexts, or mapping the event triggers backend/QA agents will need.

security-engineer.description: Principal security engineer. Use to audit code or infra for OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, insecure deserialization, weak crypto, and unsafe defaults. Returns a structured report with severity-ranked findings.

frontend-engineer.description: Lead Vue 3 frontend engineer. Use to build Composition-API + TSX components that are WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, fully testable (data-testid everywhere), and architected as a real-time reflection of a backend event bus.

docs-writer.description: Technical writer and API documentation specialist. Use to generate OpenAPI/Swagger specs, READMEs, runbooks, AGENTS.md, and API reference docs from existing code. Follows CODING_STANDARDS.md §3 documentation conventions.

backend-engineer.description: Lead Go backend engineer for high-concurrency, event-driven, hexagonal services. Use to scaffold Go services, design gRPC/Protobuf APIs, write idempotent NATS/Kafka consumers, or wire OpenTelemetry + Prometheus into a service.
